name: v2_inverse_synthetic
description: Synthetic inverse problem (1C, 1 mV Gaussian noise on the 436 reference voltage samples): recover the multipliers of D_p, k_n and D_n (true value 1) starting from 2.5, 0.4 and 0.6, with fields and parameters trained jointly from scratch. Parameter choice from scripts/v2_identifiability.py (CRLB at 1C: 0.6 %, 3 %, 4.5 %). Warm start from a forward run with --init is optional.
